title: Assertion Schema
description: A claim. ASSERTION != TRUTH (Vol 1 §8-9): an assertion records that someone claims something is true, not that it is - so it may hold ONLY an agent-writable (uncertain) status, never an author-only/authoritative one. The status enum below mirrors REGISTRIES/artifact-statuses.yaml:agent_writable (the registry is the single source of truth; enforced by TOOLS/lore_validate.py Check 4). First core-ontology primitive made enforceable (DECISION-ONTOLOGY-ENFORCEABILITY-001, closes P5-1 for this primitive).

status.description: MUST be agent-writable (ASSERTION != TRUTH). Mirrors registry agent_writable.

evidence.description: object-ref id(s) of supporting evidence. References, not inlined objects (ALIAS != IDENTITY, OBJECT_REF != OBJECT).

authority.description: object-ref id(s) of the authority relied upon. Referencing authority does NOT make the assertion authoritative (EVIDENCE/AUTHORITY are separate from the claim).
